ios.desc:
AIHabitPro helps you turn small daily actions into lasting routines.
Designed to be lightweight, distraction-free, and privacy-first, it gives you just the right tools to track habits, stay motivated, and build streaks—without clutter or pressure.


Build Better Habits, Simply

• Add habits in seconds with a clean, minimal interface.
• Organize by Morning, Afternoon, and Evening so you focus on the right task at the right time.
• Complete with a tap and watch your streak grow—instant motivation.


Stay on Track

• Set gentle reminders at your preferred times.
• See only what matters now—overdue tasks stay hidden until you choose to review them.
• Stay consistent daily without feeling overwhelmed.


Motivation That Works

• Track streaks for every habit and celebrate progress.
• Get AI-powered habit suggestions to keep your routine fresh.
• Stay inspired offline with built-in fallback ideas.


Privacy-First Design

• Local-first storage with SwiftData—your data stays on your device.
• No sign-up required—just start instantly.
• Optional anonymous analytics only—never any tracking.


Why AIHabitPro?

Unlike complex productivity apps, AIHabitPro is built around small, repeatable wins.
Whether you’re building a morning routine, staying focused with ADHD, or tracking workouts, AIHabitPro helps you stay consistent and motivated without distractions.


Key Features at Launch

• Local-first habit tracking (add, edit, delete, repeat).
• Morning / Afternoon / Evening organization.
• Streaks that reset only if you miss a day.
• Daily reminders with a time picker.
• AI-powered suggestions with offline fallback.
• Friendly design with accessibility support.


Coming Soon (Free Updates)

• Categories & smart filtering.
• Weekly repeat patterns.
• Achievement badges & progress insights.


Start simple, grow daily, and let AIHabitPro be your personal AI habit coach.





Subscription Details:

AIHabitPro is a subscription-based habit tracking app. Some features require an active subscription. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://www.aihabitpro.com/privacy
Terms: https://www.aihabitpro.com/terms
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

show_hn.title: Show HN: AIHabitPro: AI-powered habit tracker with smart suggestions and streaks

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I just launched AIHabitPro, a lightweight iOS habit tracker that uses AI to suggest personalized daily habits based on your goals, time of day, and behavior. It’s built with SwiftUI and OpenAI under the hood, and focuses on minimal UI + daily momentum with streak tracking.

This was born out of frustration with rigid habit apps that felt like more work than help. Would love feedback from this community — both on the idea and execution. I’m also exploring how to make it more open and extensible.

Thanks for checking it out!
